Liiga player stat tables

Source: R/liiga.R
liiga_player_stats.Rd

Player stat table summed over a season range, by data_type (the whole league, unfiltered).

Usage

liiga_player_stats(
  season_from,
  season_to,
  tournament,
  data_type = "basicStats"
)

Arguments

season_from

First season (END year) of the range, e.g. 2026.

season_to

Last season (END year) of the range, e.g. 2026.

tournament

Tournament: runkosarja (regular season), playoffs, playout, qualifications, valmistavat_ottelut (preseason) or chl (Champions Hockey League).

data_type

Stat table: basicStats, basicStatsGk, advancedStats, goalStats, shotStats, skatingStats, faceOffStats, penaltyStats, powerplayPenaltykillStats, passes, winningShotComp, winningShotCompGk, gameTime.

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble (45 columns; zero rows when a valid payload has none).

col_nametypedescription
player_idintegerPlayer id; the same number in lineups, rosters, stat tables and the profile (fihaId).
team_idintegerTeam id, the number of Liiga's <num>:<slug> team key (sent as that string, a bare integer or a digit string depending on the route).
team_namecharacterTeam's display name, e.g. HPK or Tappara.
team_short_namecharacterTeam abbreviation.
rolecharacterPosition: CENTER, LEFT_WING, RIGHT_WING, LEFT_DEFENSEMAN, RIGHT_DEFENSEMAN, SEVENTH_DEFENSEMAN, GOALIE.
first_namecharacterPlayer's first name.
last_namecharacterPlayer's last name.
nationalitycharacterNationality, 3-letter code.
tournamentcharacterTournament of the summed row as Liiga labels it, e.g. regular.
picture_urlcharacterURL of the player's photo.
previous_teams_for_tournamentcharacterEarlier teams of a player traded during the tournament.
injuredlogicalTrue when the player is listed as injured.
jerseyintegerJersey (sweater) number the player wore.
last_seasonintegerLast season (END year) of the range in which the player appears.
goalkeeperlogicalTrue when the player is a goalkeeper.
gamesintegerGames (player, summed over the season range).
played_gamesintegerPlayed games (player, summed over the season range).
rookielogicalTrue when Liiga flags the player as a rookie.
suspendedlogicalTrue when the player is listed as suspended.
removedlogicalRemoved from the roster.
time_on_iceintegerTime on ice (player, summed over the season range). Seconds.
currentlogicalPlayer is on the team now.
is_u20logicalTrue when Liiga flags the player as under 20 (U20).
golden_helmetsintegerGolden helmets (Liiga's team points-leader helmet; reading unverified), summed over the season range.
alumni_pointsintegerAlumni points (meaning undocumented by Liiga), summed over the season range.
goalsintegerGoals (player, summed over the season range).
assistsintegerAssists (player, summed over the season range).
pointsintegerPoints (player, summed over the season range).
plusintegerOn ice for goals for (the + of plus/minus).
minusintegerOn ice for goals against (the - of plus/minus).
plus_minusintegerPlus/minus: on-ice goals for minus on-ice goals against.
penalty_minutesintegerPenalty minutes (player, summed over the season range).
powerplay_goalsintegerPowerplay goals (player, summed over the season range).
penaltykill_goalsintegerPenaltykill goals (player, summed over the season range).
winning_goalsintegerWinning goals (player, summed over the season range).
shotsintegerShots (player, summed over the season range).
shots_into_goalintegerShots into goal (player, summed over the season range).
expected_goalsnumericExpected goals (xG) of the player's shots summed over the season range, from Liiga's undocumented model.
contest_wonintegerContests (puck battles; definition unverified) the player won, summed over the season range.
contest_lostintegerContests (puck battles; definition unverified) the player lost, summed over the season range.
goals_to_empty_goalintegerGoals to empty goal (player, summed over the season range).
time_on_ice_avgnumericTime on ice (player, summed over the season range). Seconds per game.
contest_won_percentagenumericShare of contests won, 0-100, over the season range (definition unverified).
xgenumericGoals minus expectedGoals over the season range (4 goals on 5.0956 xG = -1.0956).
shot_percentagenumericShot percentage (player, summed over the season range). Percent, 0-100.

Details

Endpoint: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/players/stats/summed/{season_from}/{season_to}/{tournament}/true

Seasons are END years (2026 = 2025-26), the same key as sdv-py. Requests to liiga.fi are spaced at least one second apart. A request Liiga answers with nothing (an unknown game, a tournament not played that season, a shot map before 2016) raises fastRhockey_no_data; a failed fetch or an error-shaped answer raises fastRhockey_asset_fetch; a bad argument raises fastRhockey_bad_request.

The columns below are those of the default data_type; the other tables carry their own stat columns next to team_id / player_id.
